svg.text: Nest and cut plate S355 16 mm, 4 segments plus stiffeners
Roll each segment to the duct profile (TL-KAP-007)
Assemble segments on a jig, weld seams and stiffeners (WPS)
Machine the throat Ø to +2/0, roundness 2 mm
Blast Sa 2½, epoxy system Im1, fit anodes
Press-form 12 mm gores for the nose and tail; roll the cylindrical ring
Weld gores and rings with internal frames, full penetration
Air test 0.5 bar, hold 0.2 bar for 1 h
Waterjet or plasma from plate, t as drawing TL-KAP-008
Weld box, chamfer edges, weld top flange
Formwork with chamfer strips; place rebar cage, anchor plate and lifting anchors
Pour C35/45, vibrate, cure 7 days wet
TEACHING MODEL — materials, tolerances and wall thicknesses are assumptions. Not for construction.
